title: Pure Fossil
summary: Pure Fossil Fusion excavation and OTK build, utilizing Jim Crocodile Cook's Rock archetype and GY banishment mechanics with staples. The deck mills Rock materials to search Fossil Fusion, excavating both players' graveyards to summon Level 4, 6, and 8 Fossil Fusion behemoths before upgrading them via Time Stream.

summary.title: Starters & Rock Milling
points: Weathering Soldier searches Fossil Fusion or any card mentioning it (such as Miracle Rupture or Time Stream) whenever it is sent to the GY by card effect or destroyed by battle.
Miracle Rupture sends a Level 4 or lower Rock monster (Weathering Soldier, Flint Cragger, or Shell Knight) from the Deck to the GY, and draws 1 card if Fossil Fusion is in your GY.
Flint Cragger sends a Fossil Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY when Special Summoned, burns for 500, and recycles Fossil Fusion or Rock cards from the GY or banishment.
Shell Knight burns for 500 when sent to the GY, and if sent by a card effect while Fossil Fusion is in your GY, adds or Special Summons a Level 8 Rock monster.

summary.title: Opening: Miracle Rupture
steps: Activate Miracle Rupture to send Weathering Soldier directly from your Deck to the GY.
Trigger Weathering Soldier in the GY to search Fossil Fusion from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Fossil Fusion, banishing Weathering Soldier from your GY and an opponent's monster from their GY (or a Rock from yours).
Fusion Summon Fossil Warrior Skull Knight (Level 6) if using a Level 5 or 6 opponent monster, or Fossil Machine Skull Buggy (Level 4).
Banish Skull Buggy or Skull Bone from the GY to search a Fossil monster or Time Stream to climb into Level 8 bosses.

summary.title: Graveyard Fusion & Time Stream
points: Fossil Fusion banishes materials from either player's GY to summon Rock Fossil Fusions; if materials were taken from both GYs, the summoned monster is immune to targeting by monster effects.
Time Stream tributes a Fossil Fusion Monster to Special Summon a Fossil Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck that is 2 Levels higher, ignoring its summoning conditions.
Specimen Inspection forces the opponent to send a monster of a declared Type and Level from their hand or Deck to the GY, stocking their graveyard with required Fossil Fusion materials.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoffs
points: Fossil Warrior Skull King (Level 8) can make 2 attacks on monsters each Battle Phase, inflicts piercing damage, and as a Quick Effect during the opponent's turn discards 1 card to Special Summon a monster from their GY.
Fossil Dragon Skullgios (Level 8) swaps the ATK and DEF of opponent monsters it battles, inflicts double piercing damage, and turns high DEF walls into lethal damage.

Fossil Machine Skull Convoy (Level 8) reduces all opponent monsters' ATK by their original DEF, attacks monsters up to 3 times per Battle Phase, and burns for 1000 whenever it destroys an opponent monster.
Skull Knight and Skull Wagon can banish themselves from the GY to destroy an opponent monster or Spell/Trap respectively.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo is Forbidden in the TCG and omitted from the build.

main: Starter Rock: searches Fossil Fusion or a card that names it when sent to the GY.
Newest Rock: mills a Fossil Fusion Monster; burns and recycles.
Newest Rock: burns; fetches a Level 8 Rock when it leaves.
Fusion Summons a Fossil by banishing materials from either GY.
Mills a Level 4 or lower Rock; draws with Fossil Fusion in the GY.
Tributes a Fossil Fusion for one two Levels higher.
Makes them mill a monster of the Type and Level you name.
extra: Level 4: attacks twice; searches Time Stream from the GY.
Level 4: piercing; searches Fossil Fusion from the GY.
Newest Level 4: burns; searches a Fossil Fusion monster from the GY.
Level 6: attacks again; destroys a monster from the GY.
Newest Level 6: attacks twice; destroys a Spell/Trap from the GY.
Level 8: attacks twice; steals a monster from their GY.
Level 8: swaps ATK and DEF in battle.
Newest Level 8: shrinks their monsters; attacks three times.
